title: POP
summary: Official Derivative glossary page for POPs, covering Point Operators as a GPU-accelerated operator family for 3D geometry or general numeric data, Render TOP rendering, external device workflows, OP Snippets, and the POP Class reference.
guidance: Use this article when a plan needs a compact grounding for why POPs are the correct family for point geometry, numeric GPU data, or device-bound point streams.
POPs work with 3D geometry or general numeric data and run on GPU-accelerated graphics cards or chips.
Render POP networks through Render TOP or route their data toward systems such as DMX lighting, LED arrays, lasers, and other external outputs.
Use Help > OP Snippets for live POP examples and the POP Class page when Python access to POP attributes or dimensions is needed.
